notes.title: Our Next Game Just Dropped!
notes.content:
[h3][b]From thrilling heists in Slippery Flippers, embark on a new story in Love's Crescendo where you'll ignite your passion for music.[/b][/h3]

[h2]📣Today is the launch day for Love's Crescendo 📣[/h2]
We're pleased to present our latest game, Love's Crescendo, a cozy rhythm game visual novel about finding true love and reigniting that spark for your passions. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472619/be55528878e2c511409736b85a248ffc6f85b303.png[/img]

[h2]🎹 Play Rhythm Games with an Original Soundtrack 🎹[/h2]
Love's Crescendo features 10 magnificent, original songs by our composers. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472619/3e2c9090cf7d55a04cb3b7003afcb0848f1e5128.png[/img]

[h2]💿 Jukebox 💿[/h2]
Love's Crescendo has replay value! Play the rhythm games outside of the story via the jukebox for an unlimited amount of fun~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472619/5ab019625b4f4731ee3059c394305acdeb713f07.jpg[/img]

[h2]💕31,000+ words of wholesome sapphic romance 💕 [/h2]
Our story features two lovely ladies as they fall in love, both with their music and with each other. <3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472619/471799cadf662708a9d2cef60e39fce4b2d9cb08.png[/img]

[h2]🎨8 Vibrant CGs🎨[/h2]
We have 8 CGs that perfectly capture the moments in the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472619/3fa213eab2eef3cb2e2c66ee28de8e8bd7ac2550.png[/img]

[h2]☕ A cozy gaming experience ☕[/h2]
Overall, we wanted Love's Crescendo to be a cozy gaming experience where players can enjoy a non-competitive rhythm game alongside a heartwarming story. If you're looking for a rhythm game that's low-stress, this one is perfect for you. It's okay if you don't get perfect scores, it won't affect the outcome of the story!

[previewyoutube=XYjicnrOpbo;full][image: KISS GIF][/previewyoutube]

[i][b]Thank you for reading!~[/b][/i]
